_approach: The 'return of the kick' moment: bar 1 runs on hats, ride and a clap alone with no kick at all (as if coming out of a breakdown), then the kick reappears on the downbeat of bar 2 at full velocity alongside a crash — the single most anticipated hit in a techno set. Ride and hat density step up through bar 1 so the silence where the kick should be reads as tension, not emptiness.
